track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why
summary: Agents that investigate a personal data breach across separate systems and tell the data protection officer, within the 72-hour GDPR window, whether to notify the supervisory authority and the affected people, and why.

sponsor_technologies.nvidia: Nemotron via the hosted NVIDIA API; explains and assesses evidence, never decides
